summary: Two students from Cologne, ages 17 and 18, are accused of plotting an attack at their school on Nov. 20, the first anniversary of the shooting at Geschwister Scholl school in Emsdetten carried out by 18-year-old ex-student Sebastian Bosse, who wounded six by gunshot and others with smoke bombs before killing himself. The 17-year-old killed himself on Friday after a confrontation with a high school teacher and police officers, and the plot was uncovered when a school principal discovered a webpage the 17-year-old had created that glorified the Columbine perpetrators. The 18-year-old is in police custody and has confessed, and Cologne police seized two crossbows, two air guns, instructions on how to build a pipe bomb and a list of potential victims after being alerted the plot would have taken place at the Georg-Büchner Gymnasium in the Weiden district; the items were confiscated at their homes.
